title: Sir Patrick Stewart, actor in Star Trek and X-Men, has died at 86
dek: His family says he died on 28 October. Fans of two franchises know him as Captain Picard or Professor X.
what: The Hollywood Reporter and IGN posted on X on 29 October 2026 that the actor Sir Patrick Stewart has died at 86. Playbill reports that his family announced it in a statement.

Playbill reports that the statement says he died on 28 October at his home in Los Angeles, from Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. It reports that he is survived by his wife, Sunny, and that the family asks for gifts to Alzheimer's research organizations in place of flowers. I read the cause and the family's request only in Playbill's account.

Playbill describes a career that began with the Royal Shakespeare Company, where he was a member from 1966 to 1982, and that includes Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men films.

PopBase posted that his final on-screen role will be Professor X in Avengers: Doomsday. I could not find a source outside X for that claim, so it rests on the post alone. Other posts in the capture single out his voice role as Avery Bullock on the animated series American Dad.
why: He held two roles that fans of different franchises each treat as their own, and the news reached all of them at once. Posts about each role spread side by side.
next: Any statement from the studio about Avengers: Doomsday, which would settle the claim about his last role.

sources.label: Playbill: Beloved Actor Patrick Stewart Has Died at 86
